releaseNotes.en:
## 1.6.16 Auto Retry & Fixes 🔁

- Added the mathjax-engine component, powering high-performance rendering in YOLO Whiteboard.
- Model requests now retry automatically, up to 3 times, when rate-limited or the service is overloaded. (#642)
- The annotation editor is now multi-line, so long annotations can be read in full while editing; fixed it being covered by the scrollbar near the right edge. (#639)
- Fixed the context-usage ring and send button rendering as squares under third-party themes such as Primary. (#641)
releaseNotes.zh:
## 1.6.16 自动重试与问题修复 🔁

- 新增 mathjax-engine 组件，服务 YOLO 白板的高性能渲染。
- 模型请求被限流或服务过载时自动重试，最多重试 3 次。（#642）
- 批注编辑框改为多行，长批注编辑时能完整看到；修复贴右时被滚动条遮挡的问题。（#639）
- 修复上下文圆环和发送按钮在 Primary 等第三方主题下显示成方块的问题。（#641）

it.name: Modalità di apprendimento

releaseNotes.en:
## 0.1.4 Cross-Device Learning Data Sync 🔄

- Learning data (spaced-repetition state and Anki import journals) now lives in the visible `data/` directory inside your vault, so sync tools like Obsidian Sync can replicate your review progress across devices. Existing data is migrated automatically.
- Requires YOLO Core 1.6.5 or later, which performs the storage migration before the module activates.
releaseNotes.zh:
## 0.1.4 学习数据跨设备同步 🔄

- 学习数据（间隔重复状态与 Anki 导入日志）迁至 vault 内可见的 `data/` 目录，Obsidian Sync 等同步工具可跨设备同步复习进度；存量数据自动迁移。
- 需要 YOLO Core 1.6.5 及以上版本（Core 会在模块激活前完成存储迁移）。

it.description: Una tela infinita per il pensiero spaziale: disponi testi e schede di ogni tipo, collegali tra loro e leggi/annota i PDF accanto alle tue note.

releaseNotes.en:
## 0.1.0 In-House Engine 🚀

- Migrated the YOLO Whiteboard core to an in-house engine, greatly improving performance.
- Framed areas on scanned PDFs can now be connected, so you can jump from an annotation back to the area and see it highlighted. (#640)
- Ctrl/Cmd+V now pastes straight into the whiteboard, with text pasted as frameless text; unified the naming of "cards" and "text".
releaseNotes.zh:
## 0.1.0 自研引擎 🚀

- 将 YOLO 白板核心迁移为自研引擎，大幅优化性能表现。
- 白板扫描版 PDF 的框选区域支持连线，可从批注跳回原区域并高亮。（#640）
- 白板支持 Ctrl/Cmd+V 直接粘贴，文字粘贴为无框文字；统一「卡片 / 文字」命名。
